args.summary:
Average bill length for Adelie penguins by island (20 rows used): Biscoe 38.80 mm, Dream 37.43 mm, Torgersen 39.39 mm.

Problems found and handled:
- island had 3 cells with stray spaces ("Biscoe " x2, " Biscoe" x1) that would have split Biscoe into three separate groups — merged into "Biscoe" with normalize_labels (approved).
- 2 exact duplicate rows (rows 7 and 11) — removed with drop_duplicates (approved) so those penguins aren't double-counted.
- species labels were clean (only Adelie/Chinstrap/Gentoo), and bill_length_mm had no missing values, no text-stored numbers, no negatives, and nothing outside the rules range 30–60 mm.

Caveats (columns not used by this question, so left unchanged):
- flipper_length_mm has one impossible negative value (-187, row 21) against the rules range 170–235.
- body_mass_g is stored as text with thousands separators and contains two implausible values (3,800,000 and 3,150,000 g vs the rules range 2500–6500 g).
These do not affect the bill-length averages but should be fixed before any analysis of flipper length or body mass.
